artifacts.summary: Widened-scope audit: retired-tactic prose in 9 files (API_REFERENCE.md worst, naming 6 nonexistent tactics), leansearch-*.md disposition options, implementation-status.md refresh needs, confirmed 5-way naming inconsistency, ENFORCE_C9_DOCS CI-flip mechanics (no new CI step needed), and a verified-dead ADR-004 task-276 citation.

memory_candidates.content: In BimodalLogic, when check-module-invariants.sh's ENFORCE_<CHECK> flags already run unconditionally in .github/workflows/ci.yml with no per-flag environment overrides in the workflow file, 'wiring a check into CI' for an already-invoked script reduces to flipping the script's own default (e.g. ENFORCE_C9_DOCS=${ENFORCE_C9_DOCS:-0} -> :-1); CI picks it up automatically. Verify by grepping the workflow file for the flag name before assuming a new step is needed.

After a vault operation (specs/state.json vault_count > 0), task-number citations in docs outside specs/** are not just stale-but-harmless anchors -- some are actively wrong, because task numbers get reused. Verify each citation resolves against specs/, specs/archive/, and specs/vault/ before deciding rewrite-vs-mark; a citation to a task-number/slug pair that no longer exists anywhere (e.g. ADR-004's specs/276_investigate_remove_redundant_project_level_state_json/, where 276 is now a different task) must be rewritten to drop the number, not task-ref-ok-marked, since marking would assert a false provenance claim.
